root_cause_label: Wrong mental model of RLE free-block pointer arithmetic: agent believed removing the explicit free-run skip and relying on Whsize_hd was correct, when the fix required keeping the skip and changing the loop increment from Whsize_hd(hd) to wh
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly diagnosed the double-advance bug in pool_sweep but applied an incorrect fix at step 34 by removing the free-run skip while retaining Whsize_hd as the loop increment, then oscillated between mutually inconsistent wrong variants (steps 34, 38, 63, 65) without ever converging on the correct one-line change of p += Whsize_hd(hd) to p += wh.
t_err_evidence: Step 34 edits shared_heap.c to remove 'p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd)' (the contiguous free-block skip) from the free-block branch while keeping 'p += Whsize_hd(hd)' as the loop increment. The agent's comment claims 'p will be advanced by Whsize_hd(hd) below, which includes all contiguous free blocks.' This is wrong: Whsize_hd(hd) = wh*(Wosize_hd(hd)+1) only equals the full run length when Wosize_hd(hd) reflects the run, but the loop increment must always advance by exactly wh (the sizeclass slot) per iteration; free-run skipping must be done separately with p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd). The agent removed the skip while keeping the wrong increment.
t_commit_evidence: Step 38 reintroduces 'p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd); p += wh; continue;' inside the free-block branch, which now over-advances by adding both the explicit run skip and wh for the current block in the free branch, then also falls through to p += Whsize_hd(hd) for live blocks. After this edit the segfault persists through all remaining builds (steps 39, 44, 51, 64). The agent never identifies and applies the single correct change (replace 'p += Whsize_hd(hd)' with 'p += wh' in the trailing loop increment while keeping the free-run skip).
t_surface_evidence: Step 36 build output: 'make[2]: *** [Makefile:147: camlinternalFormatBasics.cmi] Segmentation fault (core dumped)' - first observable failure signal after the step-34 fix.
trigger_explanation: At step 34, the agent acts on the false premise that Whsize_hd(hd) correctly advances past all contiguous free blocks on its own, making the explicit skip 'p += wh * Wosize_hd(hd)' redundant. In reality, for pool_sweep's fixed-slot loop, the trailing increment must always advance by wh (one slot), not by Whsize_hd(hd) which varies with the object size. The correct fix is to keep the free-run skip and change only the trailing loop increment. The agent never reads pool_allocate carefully enough to understand that Wosize_hd(hd) in the free-block header encodes the count of *following* same-sized slots, so the combined skip should be wh*(Wosize_hd(hd)+1) total - achieved by the skip plus the trailing wh, not by Whsize_hd alone.
forewarning_evidence: Step 36 build produces segfault: 'Segmentation fault (core dumped)' during stdlib compilation. This is between t_err (34) and t_commit (38), showing the fix from step 34 does not work.
